task: Publish explicit approval of conditional workflow recommendations and Council of High Intelligence failure-handling/review policy.

constraints.scope: Publish approved choices and downloadable setup instructions. Preserve scanner and host-readiness requirements; do not treat all candidates as mandatory.
constraints.user_approval: Yea good idea. Alright all your recommendations so far are approved. Make sure its published so I can download to use

decision.status: User selections and instructions approved and recorded; optional installations/runtime validation not completed.
decision.selected: Council of High Intelligence as conditional decision-review skill; Superpowers remains preferred software method.
council_policy: Use existing source skill; disclose host adaptations.
Continue reduced panel only with at least two actual responding workers and explicit participation gaps; otherwise stop checkpoint.
Never count simulated responses as independent review; overrides upstream simulated fallback.
review_policy: Use separate worker for agreed independent review where host supports it.
Disclose coordinator self-review if independent execution unavailable.
decision.approval_interpretation: Accept conditional recommendations and their deferrals, not blanket activation of all alternatives. Existing approvals should be reused within unchanged scope. New scanner findings, provider charges and project-specific unseen combinations retain applicable rules.
decision.download_readiness: Existing three-skill advisor core remains packaged. Optional council/Superpowers/specialists require actual-device verification and preparation if missing; no claim they are bundled or tested by this publication.

unperformed: No new optional payload installation or full audit

feedback.text: User accepts retry/reduced-participation/stop policy and approves recommendations with request to publish.

revisit_when: Council or review skill upstream changes
Actual host cannot support required workers
New review findings or changed project scope
